notice.title: Recover missing agent conversations
notice.shortMessage: Lost chats after a worktree switch? Reindex from the dashboard — transcripts in your configured lookback window are restored safely.
notice.message: If your agent sidebar lost chats after a worktree switch, branch change, or workspace path mismatch, open the CCM dashboard and run **Reindex missing conversations**. The tool rebuilds indexes from on-disk agent transcripts without deleting existing data. Quit the editor first only if Mission Control policy requires it.

discord.title: 🧠 Agent conversation recovery
discord.summary: CCM can rebuild orphaned agent chats from local transcripts after worktree switches.

discord.title: 📈 Usage advisory
discord.summary: Remind beta testers to watch budget caps and fallback model settings in CCM.

notice.title: CCM + Cursor Agent
notice.shortMessage: Keep the dashboard open while agents run — usage, security scan, and conversation recovery stay in sync.
notice.message: While Cursor Agent edits your repo, CCM monitors API usage locally, scans for leaked secrets on save, and can recover missing agent threads after worktree changes. Open **Settings** in the dashboard to tune polling and notices.
